in_hebrew.name: Lory
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Lory הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'daphne', meaning 'laurel'. In Greek mythology, Daphne was a nymph who was saved from Apollo's affections by being transformed into a laurel tree.

in_greek.name: Lory
in_greek.long_meaning: Lory είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek word 'daphne', meaning 'laurel'. In Greek mythology, Daphne was a nymph who was saved from Apollo's affections by being transformed into a laurel tree.

in_latin.name: Lory
in_latin.long_meaning: Lory est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek word 'daphne', meaning 'laurel'. In Greek mythology, Daphne was a nymph who was saved from Apollo's affections by being transformed into a laurel tree.
